snippet.title: Nothing Strange Here - Cinematic Trailer | Cozy Mystery Game
snippet.description:
Explore Larcenest Gap as an investigative journalist. Take photos, publish articles, and watch the town change with your choices. Complete cozy, funny, and mysterious quests, uncover strange secrets, and spot gnomes hiding around every corner.

Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3664070/Nothing_Strange_Here/
